Name: Dagger
Description: A short sword. Simple and effective. Fits in one hand.

Name: Sword
Description: A balanced hand-and-a-half sword. Reliable in any battle.

Name: Icy Sword
Description: A frost-enchanted blade. Slows the wielder slightly but boosts Wrath.

Name: Flaming Sword
Description: Burns hot — powerful but shaves a hair off your Speed.

Name: Hand Axe
Description: A compact one-handed axe. Built for fast strikes.

Name: Battle Axe
Description: A fearsome two-handed axe. Huge power at a speed cost.

Name: Icy Axe
Description: Crafted in the northern wastes. Cold fury on every swing.

Name: Fire Axe
Description: Burns like hell on impact. Leaves a scorched edge.

Name: Wooden Shield
Description: A hand-painted shield carved from hardwood. Blocks simple blows.

Name: Metal Shield
Description: A forged metal barrier. Heavier than wood but far sturdier.

Name: Heaven Shield
Description: A blessed tower shield that radiates holy light.

Name: Death Shield
Description: Forged in hellfire. Offers offense as well as defense.

Name: Leather Armor
Description: Light and comfortable. Great mobility with decent protection.

Name: Chain Mail
Description: Interlinked metal rings. Solid protection without full-plate weight.

Name: Icy Plate
Description: A full suit of frost-forged plate. Near-impenetrable but very heavy.

Name: Obsidian Plate
Description: The ultimate armor. You are immovable — for better or worse.

Name: Shovel
Description: Not a weapon — but it'll do in a pinch. Raises Luck oddly.
